text:
maia: Quick sync — we need to finalize the response schema for launch. main asks: token usage fields, trace ids, toolcall shape, structured outputs, and what is MUST vs NICE for v1.
ranjan: Proposed minimal: token_usage.total, token_usage.prompt, token_usage.completion — integers. trace.id as 'x-trace-id' UUID. model.name + model.version. route.
oli: +1 but suggest token units be explicit: billing_units vs raw_tokens; some customers need 'input_units' vs 'gen_units'.
sam: Can we keep naming snake_case? product prefers snake_case for schema fields. avoid dots in top-level keys.
adele: From CS — customers ask for request_id (client-provided) and canonical trace id to match logs. Also need user_id hashing for PII.
maia: Ok decision: snake_case top-level. token_usage: {total,prompt,completion,billing_units}. trace: trace_id (uuid), span_id optional. request_id optional but recommended. model: name, version.
ranjan: Tool calls: array 'tool_calls' with items: {name:string, args: string|object, success: bool, duration_ms: int}. include 'tool_version' optional.
oli: Structured output: we agreed 'structured_output_v1' as a typed envelope: {schema: "structured_output_v1", type: string, value: ...}. This prevents ambiguity and future migrations.
sam: How about sensitive fields? We should avoid returning raw user content in metadata. Add 'redaction' flag and 'user_hash' instead of user_id.
adele: Launch criteria checklist suggestion:
- must: token_usage, trace_id, model fields, tool_calls array, structured_output_v1 envelope
- nice: billing_units, span_id, route, user_hash, deterministic_request_id
- blocked by: SDK support (python/js), docs, and console dashboards
maia: timeline idea: finish schema PR by EOD Thu (3 days), SDKs next week, docs and console wk after. can we hit beta in 3 weeks?
ranjan: I can land runtime changes for token counters + trace propagation in 10 days. SDK work parallel.
oli: I'll draft the structured_output_v1 spec today and put examples for tool calling + rerank.
sam: I'll add the fields to the API changelog and open a doc for migration guide.
adele: I'll line up 2 customer partners for early feedback (fintech + healthcare) — will need private deployment notes.
maia: Action items: ranjan (runtime counters + trace) due 1943813565, oli (struct spec) due 1943300000, sam (sdk PR) due 1943500000, adele (customer outreach) due 1943400000. We'll reconvene Fri.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: schema-experiments branch -> staging at 1943260000 :rocket:
maia: Thanks all. If anyone has blocking concerns call them out now, otherwise I'll cut the schema PR tomorrow morning.
ranjan: one note — confirm token counting rules for streaming vs non-streaming. I'll post a short doc.
oli: Also propose an example payload for rerank responses: include 'ranks' array with 'score' and 'tokens' used per candidate.
sam: ACK, I'll make the migration guide include server->client example change logs and a small snippet:
```
response = {
  "token_usage": {"total": 125, "prompt": 30, "completion": 95},
  "trace_id": "8a7b...",
  "structured_output_v1": {"schema": "structured_output_v1", "type": "json_schema", "value": {...}}
}
```
adele: :thumbsup: good.
maia: End thread.
